items.title: Use the canonical full-suite budget in the result artifact
items.context: Replace the numeric shadow copy in full-suite-runner.ts with FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS and add a focused smoke assertion that rejects a future hard-coded performanceBudgetMs value.
items.userSees: The full-suite JSON result contains `"performanceBudgetMs": 1200000`, and `npm run test:full-suite-runner-smoke` prints `full-suite-runner-smoke: PASS`.
excludes: Changing FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS or runtime budget enforcement
Changing scheduler concurrency or entry timeouts

happy.desc: Inspect the production result writer and build packages/main: it contains exactly one performanceBudgetMs initializer, that initializer references FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS, no numeric performanceBudgetMs initializer remains, and the build exits 0.

items.title: Add regression coverage for canonical full-suite budget telemetry
items.context: The writer fix is one line and could silently regress to another numeric shadow copy. Extend full-suite-runner-smoke.ts with a focused assertion that requires performanceBudgetMs to reference FULL_SUITE_BUDGET_MS and rejects a numeric initializer.
items.userSees: `npm run test:full-suite-runner-smoke` prints `full-suite-runner-smoke: PASS`; changing the initializer back to `300_000` makes that smoke fail.
excludes: Running or rewriting the historical B-9812 capture campaign
